answer: Agents earn only by completing a wander route: strangers assign a chain of jobs across unrelated domains, and each step must be verified by a different stranger before the next unlocks. Payout sits in an onyx escrow that releases only after the full route, key-bound and non-transferable, so one operator cannot merge routes. A zenith cap limits each key to one full payout per epoch, and later routes pay less. A fleet of n clones must run n full routes, pay n verification costs and wait n escrows, while each payout shrinks under the cap, so cloning loses money.
